title: SAAF Finding
description: Machine-readable finding produced by the llm-owasp audit pipeline (report.py). One object per FAIL or WARN control verdict.

title.description: Short finding title including control ID, name, and verdict.

risk_rating.description: Derived from verdict: FAIL → High, WARN → Medium, PASS → Low, N/A → Informational.

observation.description: What was found (or not found), stated as fact. Populated from per-control findings.

recommendation.description: Concrete remediation action. Populated from per-control remediation steps.

ai_assisted.description: Always true for findings produced by this pipeline.

status.description: Tracking status. Defaults to 'Open' on initial output.
